messages:
Maria Chen: ISO auditor just asked for evidence bundle for the last RBAC change (service-account privilege reduction) + KMS key rotation proof + vuln triage links. Can someone collate the artifacts? They want chain-of-approval, tamper-evident logs, and mapping to controls.
Devon Patel: I can grab the RBAC ticket trail. Approvals are in Jira: RD-INF-4212 and RD-OPS-4213. Approver comments are present and @legal signed off (see comment thread). I'll export PDFs. :+1:
Kevin O'Rourke: For KMS rotation, we have CloudTrail events and the KMS key metadata. Query I use: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2024-11-01 --end-time 2025-03-01``` Sample event: `RotateKeyResult: {"KeyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" ...}`
Olivia Park: I'll attach the vuln triage link and triage notes. Triage ticket is SEC-987, root cause assigned to infra, mitigation completed 2025-01-14, and regression tests passed.
sre-bot: Automated snapshot: incident-capture created for SEC-987 at s3://redwood-evidence/iso/SEC-987/snapshot-20250114.tar.gz (retention=365d)
ISO Auditor: For RBAC we need: (1) explicit who approved (id + role), (2) the diff of permissions before/after, and (3) an exportable proof that the Jira comments haven't been altered. Hash of exported PDF is preferred.
Maria Chen: Copy. Devon — can you include the pre/post IAM policy diffs and a sha256 of the exported PDF? Kevin — can you include CloudTrail event IDs and the KMS key rotation metadata (creationDate, lastRotated, rotationEnabled=true)?
Devon Patel: Will do. Pre/post diffs are under git repo infra-iam/audit/diffs/rd-inf-4212. I'll generate a signed PDF and upload to the evidence bucket. Example commands I'll run: ```git diff --no-prefix HEAD~1 HEAD infra/iam/roles/service-accounts.json > rd-inf-4212-diff.txt
docsign sign rd-inf-4212-diff.txt --out rd-inf-4212-signed.pdf
sha256sum rd-inf-4212-signed.pdf```
Kevin O'Rourke: CloudTrail event IDs: e-0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h, e-7h6g5f4e3d2c1b0a. KMS key metadata (excerpt): `{"KeyId":"abcd-ef01","CreationDate":"2022-09-10T12:00:00Z","KeyState":"Enabled","AutomaticRotation":true,"LastRotated":"2025-01-10T03:21:00Z"}`
Olivia Park: Vulnerability triage notes summary: "SEC-987: mis-scoped SA permissions allowed read-only access to non-prod. Remediation: tightened role to explicit list, rotated SA credentials, added unit tests and CI gate. Evidence: triage-notes.md, remediation-PR #563, e2e results in ci-artifacts/563/"
ISO Auditor: Also need evidence mapping to the control IDs: A.9.2.1 (user access provisioning), A.10.1 (cryptographic controls), and evidence that the incident was triaged within SLA. A short statement from the owner confirming closure is enough for SLA verification.
Maria Chen: I'll draft a brief cover note linking artifacts to those control IDs and include dates & owners. Can someone aim to upload everything to s3://redwood-evidence/iso/2025-03-audit/ by EOD tomorrow? :eyes:
Devon Patel: Target met — I'll upload RBAC artifacts and post the sha256 here once done.
Kevin O'Rourke: I'll export CloudTrail JSONs and KMS key descriptions, then upload and pin the object version (s3 version id) for immutability proof. Command I'll use: ```aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-evidence --key iso/2025-03-audit/kms-rotation-cloudtrail.json --body kms-rotation.json --tagging 'immutable=true'```
ISO Auditor: Please also include any service account rotation logs and the timestamped rotation policy. We check that credential rotation happened after the permission change.
Olivia Park: Confirmed — SA credential rotation occurred 2025-01-15 02:00 UTC, which is after the permission change 2025-01-14 18:30 UTC. I'll attach the rotation audit line.
Maria Chen: Great. Once uploads are done, reply here with the S3 URIs and the sha256 hashes. I'll compile the bundle and hand off to the auditor. Thanks everyone. :tada:
